Remarks

This converter handles the serialization and deserialization of OnixSettingColor.ValueTypeMutable objects, which represent colors and their associated metadata. During deserialization, the JSON object is expected to include properties for the color components (e.g., "r", "g", "b", and optionally "a" for alpha) as well as additional metadata such as "show_opacity", "chroma", and "rgb". Missing required color components ("r", "g", "b") will result in a null return value.

Remarks

The method serializes the value object into a JSON object with the following properties:

  • r, g, b, and a: Represent the red, green, blue, and alpha (opacity) components of the color, respectively.
  • show_opacity: A boolean indicating whether the opacity should be displayed.
  • chroma: A boolean indicating whether the color is chroma-enabled.
  • rgb: A boolean indicating whether the color is part of a rainbow effect.
